Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of WMT.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.11 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2020.
Operating income reached $13.6 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 91 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.11 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
